items.en: A mix of skills that benefit exploration, stealth, and certain aspects of your fleet and officers' combat performance.

Increases the ship's hull integrity by %s.

If disabled, the ship will not break apart and is almost always recoverable after the battle. Ships recovered after battle start with %s to %s hull integrity and combat readiness.

This effect stacks with other similar bonuses, but the combat readiness can not exceed what it would have been had the ship survived the battle.
